storage.projection_method: Enumerate sorted trial directories and sorted regular files. Stream file bytes through one fresh default zlib compressor per paired trial. Scale each observed 20-trial byte total by 7190/20 and round. This is not a created archive or a guaranteed size for unreviewed tasks.
storage.hypothetical_cache_exclusion: Only files named ed5b44d1 or c145df5f below a node-compile-cache directory were omitted from the hypothetical estimate. No file was deleted, moved or compressed on disk.
projection_excludes: Task-specific datasets and dependencies beyond the two selected pilot tasks
A safe reserve for the shared system volume
storage.node_compile_cache_probe: A separate Node process confirmed NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 disables the cache. The provider does not propagate this parent variable through its child environment whitelist; no provider change was made.
storage.decision: Do not launch the full study on this volume. Even the hypothetical compressed cache-excluded projection exceeds observed free space before reserves, and the current unmodified retention path projects approximately 42 GB raw.
